products.name: AntV G6
products.description: Complete graph visualization engine by Alibaba's Ant Group, focusing on relational data with 3D rendering, WebGL support, and optimized layout algorithms. Version 5.0+ features next-generation rendering architecture.
products.positioning: High-performance graph visualization library for complex relational data

products.name: Rete.js
products.description: TypeScript-first visual programming framework for processing-oriented node-based editors. Emphasizes framework-agnostic design with support for React, Vue, Angular, and AR/VR integration. Includes Engine module for graph processing beyond visualization.
products.positioning: Tailorable framework for creating visual programming editors with processing capabilities

products.name: Reaflow
products.description: Modular React-based diagram engine featuring ELKJS-powered automatic layout, fully customizable nodes and edges, native zooming/panning, and undo/redo state management. Designed for workflow editors and complex architecture visualization.
products.positioning: Modular diagram engine for React with automatic layout and full customization

products.name: Baklavajs
products.description: Vue.js-native node editor emphasizing modularity and extensibility via plugin system. Entire ecosystem written in TypeScript for type safety. Supports a-la-carte plugin installation for additional functionality.
products.positioning: Extensible Vue.js node editor with plugin-based architecture

products.name: Neovis.js
products.description: Neo4j-contributed JavaScript library for graph visualization using vis.js rendering. Integrates Neo4j JavaScript driver for direct database querying, executes Cypher queries for algorithm results (PageRank, community detection), and renders interactive visualizations.
products.positioning: Neo4j-specific graph visualization library with Cypher integration

products.name: Popoto.js
products.description: Neo4j-focused visual query builder enabling pattern-based querying through node-graph interface. Translates visual graph patterns into Cypher queries for data exploration and analysis on Neo4j databases.
products.positioning: Visual query builder for Neo4j with pattern-based query generation

products.name: NetworkX
products.description: Python package for creation, manipulation, and analysis of complex networks. Provides tools for studying network structure/dynamics, standard programming interfaces, support for multiple backends, and integration with numerical algorithms (C/C++/FORTRAN).
products.positioning: Python standard library for network analysis, algorithms, and study

notes: Phase C extraction for competitors-node-graph-libs-editors. Coverage: 7 core products (AntV G6, Rete.js, Reaflow, Baklavajs, Neovis.js, Popoto.js, NetworkX) with extended competitive context from 48 sources covering node-editor frameworks and graph-DB visualization libraries. Key findings: (1) Market splits into visualization-only libraries (G6, Cytoscape, D3, Sigma, ECharts) vs node-editor frameworks (Rete, Reaflow, Baklavajs). (2) Execution/orchestration rare in traditional libraries. (3) Database integration uncommon except Neovis/Popoto (Neo4j-specific). (4) MetroGraph moat: SQL/noSQL-first schema introspection + agent orchestration is a gap competitors miss. (5) AI assistance entirely absent from all traditional libraries (2025 state). Feature scoring reflects 10-16 most-relevant features per product from 56-feature node-graph-specific taxonomy; HCI costs grounded in click depth, config sprawl, onboarding time, and layout rendering performance per published benchmarks.
